src:
MOV     AH, 3Ch          ; DOS: create TEST.TXT
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX = 0: normal attributes
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK            ; stop if CF = 1
MOV     BX, AX           ; BX = the handle
MOV     AX, 5701h        ; DOS: set the date and time
MOV     CX, 63C0h        ; 12:30:00 = 12 x 2048 + 30 x 32 + 0
MOV     DX, 1ECFh        ; 1995-06-15 = 15 x 512 + 6 x 32 + 15
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; close: the stamp is written now
INT     21h
MOV     AX, 3D00h        ; open the file again
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     BX, AX
MOV     AX, 5700h        ; DOS: get the date and time
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     SI, DX           ; SI = date
MOV     DI, CX           ; DI = time
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; close the handle
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 41h          ; delete TEST.TXT
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
MOV     DX, OFFSET M1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, DI
CALL    PHEX
MOV     DX, OFFSET M2
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, SI
CALL    PHEX
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, SI           ; year: bits 15-9, + 1980
MOV     CL, 9
SHR     AX, CL
ADD     AX, 1980
CALL    PDEC
MOV     DL, "-"
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AX, SI           ; month: bits 8-5
MOV     CL, 5
SHR     AX, CL
AND     AX, 0Fh
CALL    P2
MOV     DL, "-"
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AX, SI           ; day: bits 4-0
AND     AX, 1Fh
CALL    P2
MOV     DL, " "
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AX, DI           ; hours: bits 15-11
MOV     CL, 11
SHR     AX, CL
CALL    P2
MOV     DL, ":"
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AX, DI           ; minutes: bits 10-5
MOV     CL, 5
SHR     AX, CL
AND     AX, 3Fh
CALL    P2
MOV     DL, ":"
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AX, DI           ; seconds: bits 4-0, times 2
AND     AX, 1Fh
SHL     AX, 1
CALL    P2
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h

FNAME   DB      "TEST.TXT", 0
M1      DB      "packed: time $"
M2      DB      " date $"
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
CHECK   PROC    NEAR     ; CF = 1: print the error code in AL and exit
JNC     CHECK1
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET FAILMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
CALL    PHEXB
MOV     AX, 4C01h        ; exit with code 1
INT     21h
CHECK1:
RET
CHECK   ENDP
FAILMSG DB      "failed: error $"
PHEXB   PROC    NEAR     ; print AL as two hex digits
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     DH, AL           ; keep the byte
MOV     CL, 4
SHR     AL, CL           ; the high digit first
MOV     CX, 2
PHEXB1:
AND     AL, 0Fh
ADD     AL, "0"
CMP     AL, "9"
JBE     PHEXB2
ADD     AL, 7            ; 10..15 -> "A".."F"
PHEXB2:
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AL, DH           ; then the low digit
LOOP    PHEXB1
POP     DX
POP     CX
RET
PHEXB   ENDP
PHEX    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX as four hex digits
PUSH    AX
MOV     AL, AH
CALL    PHEXB
POP     AX
CALL    PHEXB
RET
PHEX    ENDP
PDEC    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX in decimal
PUSH    BX
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX = digits pushed
PDEC1:
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; AX = AX / 10, DX = the last digit
PUSH    DX
INC     CX
OR      AX, AX
JNZ     PDEC1
PDEC2:
POP     DX               ; the digits come back first to last
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC2
POP     DX
POP     CX
POP     BX
RET
PDEC    ENDP
P2      PROC    NEAR     ; print AX (0..99) as two digits
MOV     DL, 10
DIV     DL               ; AL = tens, AH = ones
ADD     AX, 3030h        ; both to characters
PUSH    AX
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
POP     AX
MOV     DL, AH
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
RET
P2      ENDP
